Summary of what was built:

**Source structure** (`/workspace/output/`):
- `CMakeLists.txt` — C++20, std-lib only
- `src/types.h` — Vec6, Block, enums, Tool, ProbeBox
- `src/parser.h/cpp` — RS274 line parser with full expression evaluation (arithmetic, parameters, unary functions like SIN/COS/ATAN/SQRT/etc.)
- `src/machine.h/cpp` — interpreter and trace generator
- `src/json_io.h/cpp` — output and trace JSON writers
- `src/main.cpp` — CLI parsing, parameter/tool file I/O, orchestration

**Features implemented**:
- All G-codes per Table 5: motion (G0–G3, G38.2), canned cycles (G81–G89), planes (G17–G19), units (G20/G21), home (G28/G30), cutter comp (G40–G42), tool offsets (G43/G49), G53, coordinate systems (G54–G59.3), path control (G61, G61.1, G64), G80 cancel, distance (G90/G91), G92 family, feed mode (G93/G94), return mode (G98/G99), G10
- All M-codes per Table 7: M0/M1/M2/M30/M60, M3/M4/M5, M6, M7/M8/M9, M48/M49 (with proper modal group tracking and M2/M30 program-end reset)
- Order of execution per Table 8
- Sticky canned-cycle parameters (R always; W within same cycle; P, Q within same cycle)
- Probe trip detection against `--probe-box`
- Tool table file (RS274 §2.3 format) and parameter file (RS274 §3.2.1 format) I/O
- `%` file framing
- Block delete (`/`) with `--block-delete`
- Trace output with all three stepping modes (time step, distance step, position tolerance)
- Per-sub-motion `motion_kind` labels and per-line `nonmodal_g_codes` labels
- Delta-encoded trace entries with conflict-resolution for post-motion state changes
